title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed at low precision, yet quantization can degrade their performance. We study how quantization interacts with decoding settings such as the sampling temperature and top-p by examining how it distorts the model's next-token probabilities. Measuring entropy during generation across deployed temperatures, we find that quantization warms the model on average, and that temperature matters much more for the performance of a quantized model than for its full-precision counterpart. Because quantization and temperature both shape the next-token distribution, we investigate how much the sampling settings can undo what quantization changes, through our method TempQuant, which learns the quantized model's temperature and top-p to bring its next-token probabilities closer to the full-precision model's. translated_title: TempQuant：为量化语言模型学习自适应温度
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地以低精度部署，但量化可能会降低其性能。我们通过考察量化如何扭曲模型的下一词元概率，研究了量化与解码设置（如采样温度和top-p）之间的相互作用。通过在部署的各种温度下测量生成过程中的熵，我们发现量化平均上会使模型“变暖”，且温度对量化模型性能的影响远大于对全精度模型的影响。由于量化和温度都会塑造下一词元的分布，我们通过我们的方法TempQuant来探究采样设置能在多大程度上抵消量化带来的变化——该方法通过学习量化模型的温度和top-p，使其下一词元概率更接近全精度模型。我们在两个粒度上学习这些设置：第一种是针对每个请求温度学习单一的全局设置……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: TempQuant通过学习量化模型的采样温度和top-p设置，使其下一词元概率分布更接近全精度模型，从而有效缓解量化带来的性能损失，且温度对量化模型性能的影响远大于全精度模型。
en_tdlr: TempQuant learns the temperature and top-p of quantized language models to bring their next-token probabilities closer to those of full-precision models, substantially mitigating quantization-induced performance degradation.
